title: AI Research Assistant Toolkit
subtitle: Comprehensive tools and code libraries for academic research enhancement
introduction: A specialized collection of AI-powered tools and code implementations designed to accelerate academic research workflows. This toolkit includes intelligent API clients for various AI models, automated research assistants, and utility tools for data processing and analysis. Perfect for researchers, graduate students, and academics looking to integrate AI capabilities into their research methodology.

code_blocks.name: Gemini Client
code_blocks.description: Advanced Python implementation of Google's Gemini API client with intelligent features including quota management, session logging, error handling with exponential backoff, and multi-model support. Designed specifically for research applications requiring reliable and efficient AI model interactions.

code_blocks.name: Schema-Constrained JSON Generator
code_blocks.description: Enhanced GenAI client with JSON Schema validation capabilities. Built on top of the Enhanced GenAI framework, this tool ensures AI outputs conform to predefined JSON structures, making it perfect for structured data extraction, API response formatting, and consistent research data collection.

code_blocks.name: AI-Powered Paper Citation Crawler
code_blocks.description: Intelligent academic paper discovery and evaluation system that combines Semantic Scholar API with AI analysis. Features automated citation network traversal, AI-driven paper relevance scoring, batch processing with emergency save mechanisms, and comprehensive research workflow management for systematic literature reviews.

code_blocks.name: Research Results Analysis Tool
code_blocks.description: Utility for analyzing and filtering research results from emergency save files. Provides score-based filtering, detailed paper information display, and structured output for research data generated by the citation crawler system. Essential for post-processing and reviewing discovered academic papers.

code_blocks.name: Semantic Scholar API Fetcher
code_blocks.description: Comprehensive Python wrapper for Semantic Scholar API with intelligent batch processing, rate limiting, and citation network analysis. Features smart citation retrieval strategies, automatic retry mechanisms, and optimized data fetching for large-scale academic research projects.

tools.name: Academic Text Analyzer
tools.description: Comprehensive text analysis tool for research documents, providing character count, word frequency, readability metrics, and citation statistics. Supports multiple languages and academic formatting standards.

tools.name: JSON to LaTeX Proof Diagram Converter
tools.description: Convert JSON proof diagram data to LaTeX TikZ code. Features automatic node layout, topological sorting, and support for conditions, steps, conclusions, and annotations with customizable styling.

tools.name: BibTeX Converter
tools.description: Convert BibTeX format citations to LaTeX addliterature format with batch processing and one-click copy all results functionality
